methods.name: ShowDialog
methods.returnDescription: OK if the user confirmed, Cancel otherwise.
methods.description: Shows the dialog and waits until it is closed.
methods.expectedEffect: The dialog opens; the program continues after it closes.

methods.name: ShowDialog
methods.returnDescription: OK if the user confirmed, Cancel otherwise.
methods.description: Shows the dialog on top of a window you choose.

parameters.name: owner
parameters.description: The window that owns the dialog, usually this (the form).

methods.expectedEffect: The dialog opens centered over the form.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Puts all properties back to their default values.
methods.expectedEffect: The dialog starts fresh the next time it is shown.

methods.name: OpenFile
